1. F1 — **blocking, issue-impact**: Directory actions mutate state before the redo record is committed. Both backends create all `CreateDirectory` entries after the conflict check but before installing the record ([repository_state_store.rs:664](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store.rs:664), [repository_state_store.rs:772](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store.rs:772)). An interruption or record-commit failure in that window leaves newly created directories with no redo record for the next session to replay or roll back, so the repository is neither the complete old nor new state. Further, `AlreadyExists` is accepted without verifying that the occupant is a directory ([repository_state_store.rs:1003](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store.rs:1003)); a raced regular-file occupant can therefore leave a committed record that cannot apply. This violates recoverable complete-state publication. References: @/charter/D-17, @/invariant/derived-state-coherence.
